Mr. Durgesh M. Pingale, Advocate for Applicant.
Mr. R. B. Dhaware, Agp for Respondent-State.
Coram : Kishore C. Sant, J.
Date : 7th October 2025.

PC :-
1. Heard the parties.

2. Learned AGP appears even for Respondent No.3.
3. This application is filed for condonation of delay caused in filing the first appeal by the original claimant seeking enhancement in the amount of compensation under Land Acquisition Act.
At the fact that the applicant is the person who lost his land in acquisition.
This Court is inclined to allow the application and to meet the equity.

Hence, the following order:
Ethape  (2) 904-CA-13228-2024  ORDER (i) Application is allowed, subject to condition that the applicant files an undertaking stating that he shall not be entitled to receive any statutory benefits for the period of delay.
The said undertaking shall be kept in the appeal.
